introduction: Hello. Thank you for visiting this site. I am the CEO of mocomoco inc. I previously studied in the doctoral program at NAIST's NLP Lab in Japan. My technical fields of interest are NLP and web development. I mainly code in Python and Go. I also like to use HuggingFace and JAX. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me via my e-mail.
